title: More than 256 files on a drive
summary: The entries the core keeps for every file of a drive move to the card as an index beside the catalog: one fixed-width file of rows per folder in the playlist's order, a table of the folders and a map of the ids, written and committed with the catalog; the core keeps a cursor and reads a row when it needs it, so the number of files and folders is bounded by the card alone.
